'''2007 Endor Regionals Matt Hilderman LS Coruscant: Docking Bay''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Hilderman]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' TRM-FTL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
